items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I made the George Girard and the Jack Delaney and the George Lewis. By the way, I recorded George Lewis in the studio.

ctx.x: Was it a place where there was music there?

Yes, the Basin Street Six was playing there at that time, and I got the job for Johnny Wiggs and his outfit, and I came over one night and I says, Johnny, I'm going to do a little recording this band. I like it, it sounds good, it's got the old-time sound. In fact, that session put me in the business. I tried to sell it to two or three of the smaller record companies, nobody didn't like it, and I thought, well, something's wrong here. I'm going to have to try this thing myself. I did, and I sent it to a record…
The radio like WDSU, you mean?
